Ranks Montgomery census tracts by 2025 code violations per 1,000 residents, joining violation counts to tract population and ordering the rate descending with tract name as tiebreaker.
sql:
WITH violation_counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, n
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_efd90c'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
),
tract_population AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid, CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_efd90c_m2_cdc
)
SELECT
  t.name,
  (COALESCE(v.n, 0) / NULLIF(p.totalpopulation, 0) * 1000) AS code_violations_per_1000_residents,
  COALESCE(v.n, 0) AS code_violations_count,
  p.totalpopulation AS total_population,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN violation_counts v ON t.geoid = v.geoid
LEFT JOIN tract_population p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
ORDER BY code_violations_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
